content: {"praised":["Great success story of former Irish Mafia member.","Mark Ruffalo and Ethan Hawke deliver strong performances.","Authentic South Boston setting adds realism.","Engaging storyline with moral quandary.","Well-received by viewers who appreciate character-driven drama."],"criticized":["Generic gritty crime drama with no originality.","Uninteresting characters lacking depth or growth.","Jumbled first three-quarters of the film.","Lack of engaging plot or suspense early on.","Overly familiar South Boston boys gone wrong trope."]}
